name: WildGS-SLAM
definition: A robust monocular RGB 3DGS-SLAM for dynamic in-the-wild scenes. Uses a shallow MLP over DINOv2 features to predict an uncertainty map that guides dynamic-object removal during tracking and mapping, feeding uncertainty-aware dense bundle adjustment and Gaussian-map optimization.
summary: WildGS-SLAM is a monocular SLAM system that uses uncertainty-aware optimization to ignore dynamic distractors and reconstruct clean static 3D Gaussian maps.
